description: context-bench task corpus (docs/plans/falsifiability.md B1-1). Committed form of the ×10 tokenomics falsifiability gate (coding-agent-excellence.md §0/§7 gate 6). Each task's ground_truth was derived by direct grep/read of the fathom and agentic-kit repos at the commit noted in `source` — reproducible by anyone, not by querying the live fathom daemon (see internal/contextbench/task.go doc comment for the full convention). Run artifacts (raw claude -p transcripts, scored results, summary tables) are NOT committed here — they land under workspace/artifacts/context-bench/ per scripts/context-bench.sh. See `lookup_corpus_sweep` for the T5-8 drift sweep applied before the second tokenomics swing.

lookup_corpus_sweep.rule: docs/plans/trust-and-tokenomics.md T5-8 requires sweeping this grep-native corpus for ground truths invalidated by heavy commit activity since authoring (9f40934) — symbol renames, moved files, new callers — verifying each ground truth still true at HEAD and fixing drift with provenance notes, the H2/B1 criteria themselves untouched.
lookup_corpus_sweep.method: Direct grep/read of every task's cited symbol/file at worktree HEAD (never the live daemon) — re-ran each task's original `source` command verbatim and diffed the result against ground_truth.
findings: B1-T01/B1-T15 (ParseMarkdownPlan callers): cmd/fathom/plans.go (new file, a7f5156, not present at 9f40934) gained a 6th call site (computePlanRows, plans.go:91) — added to both tasks' ground_truth.
B1-T04 (verify.Plan qualified references): the same new file, cmd/fathom/plans.go, also references `[]verify.Plan` at plans.go:84 — added to ground_truth.

B1-T14 (defaultFathomURL callers): three files new since 9f40934 (cmd/fathom/plans.go, cmd/fathom/plans_archive.go, cmd/fathom/doctor.go — all post-authoring feature additions) now also call defaultFathomURL() for their --url flag default — all three added to ground_truth (6 -> 9 required entries).
B1-T02, B1-T03, B1-T05, B1-T06, B1-T07, B1-T08, B1-T09, B1-T10, B1-T11, B1-T12, B1-T13: re-verified unchanged and still accurate at HEAD bfb8010 — no drift found.
lookup_corpus_sweep.note: All three drifted tasks use scoring_rule all-of, so the fix makes them strictly HARDER (both arms must now find the additional real callers), not easier — an honest tightening, not a softening, and identically presented to both arms via the unchanged prompt text (which never enumerated a count).
